freeFeatures.text: 20 credits monthly — analysis, optimization, interview prep, cover letters

faqs.a: Your resume is processed securely — AI keys stay server-side and your files are never used to fill anyone else's resume. You can delete your data at any time from settings.
Yes — fully. Watheq auto-detects Arabic or English resumes, analyzes both, and exports RTL-ready templates. The whole app works in either language.

faqs.q: What do I get on the free plan?
faqs.a: 20 credits every month: match analysis (2), full optimization (5), interview prep (3), cover letters (4), Vision 2030 alignment (2). PDF exports and 5 templates included; referrals earn 5 extra credits per friend.

faqs.q: Will my resume pass ATS screening?
faqs.a: Watheq aligns your resume with the job ad's keywords and exports an ATS-friendly single-column format. No tool can honestly guarantee a pass rate — we improve your alignment and show you exactly what changed.

faqs.q: Can I upload a scanned PDF?
faqs.a: Not yet — Watheq needs selectable text. Upload a text-based PDF or DOCX, or simply paste your resume text. Scanned image-only files aren't supported for now.

faqs.q: Will the AI invent experience I don't have?
faqs.a: Never. When proof is missing, Watheq asks you a clarification question instead of guessing. Every suggestion stays grounded in what your resume already says.
